title: ProviderProfileList
description: Every configured LLM provider, and which one is active. Returned by providers.list. No API key appears anywhere in this type: keys travel from the renderer to the host on save and never come back (CLAUDE.md §0.2.13).

profiles.description: Configured providers, ordered by display name.

activeProfileId.description: Identifier of the provider analysis runs will use. Absent when nothing is configured yet.

providerProfile.title: ProviderProfile
providerProfile.description: One configured LLM provider. Carries whether a key is stored, never the key itself.

id.description: Stable identifier assigned by the host when the profile was first saved.

providerType.description: Which provider family this profile talks to. openai_compatible covers any endpoint speaking the OpenAI wire format, including local runtimes.

displayName.description: Name the user gave this profile, so two profiles for the same provider stay distinguishable.

model.description: Model identifier as free text. Deliberately not constrained to a list: hardcoded model lists rot.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint override. Required for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, optional elsewhere.

hasApiKey.description: True when a key for this profile is present in the secret store. The key itself never crosses the bridge.

isActive.description: True for the single profile analysis runs will use.

modelSuggestions.description: Model identifiers this key could reach, captured during the last successful connection test. Empty until a test has succeeded, because the alternative is a hardcoded list that goes stale.

inputCostPerMillion.description: US dollars per million input tokens, as the user entered it. Overrides the price table bundled with the application, which is a snapshot and goes stale. Absent when no override is set.

outputCostPerMillion.description: US dollars per million output tokens. Only takes effect alongside inputCostPerMillion: half a rate would bill the other half at zero.
